title: Reading Corso's The Day After Roswell

tellings.quote: I started rereading I read the the uh Corsos uh day after Roswell uhuh and I really started digging in that was a little after that was 97

plain: A DARPA scientist named John Blitch, who says he was once abducted by an alien, tells Michels that around 1997 he read The Day After Roswell, a book published that year by Philip J. Corso about Roswell, New Mexico, the place at the centre of the best-known crashed-UFO story. DARPA is the Pentagon's advanced research agency. Blitch says reading Corso's book is when he "really started digging in" to the subject himself.
